title: Untitled (Figure with CD)
description: Large-scale ink outline of a headless torso dominates white paper, with bold red paint pooling at the lower body suggesting wounds or viscera. Two warplane silhouettes flank the figure at upper left and right; a single compact disc is affixed at the chest, and rows of perforated dots mark both legs.
